text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as Ines Fujin and I complete the day's training regimen…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We did great out there! Feels like our training session went by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I've got a delivery job lined up after this. I think I might use it to get some solo training in.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I usually use my bike when I'm making deliveries, but this time I'll use my legs!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Being able to sweat it out on my shift makes delivering the perfect job for training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin might be raring to go, but she could very well overexert herself if she delivers everything on foot…
choice_data_list: You'll strain yourself, so ride your bike instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin makes her deliveries with all the vigor she can muster, building up her strength in the process.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Well, I guess if I end up exhausting myself, I won't be in any state to do my regular training…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Got it! If that's what you think's best, I'll go on my bike!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Earnestly heeding my request, Ines Fujin takes care not to overwork herself.
